profile.name: Scott Moss
profile.description: Scott Moss builds apps and open-source tools, does AI research, and explains how it all works on YouTube.
profile.intro: I build apps and open-source tools, do AI research, and explain how it all works on YouTube. I also help companies put AI to work, safely.

sections.title: Work with me
sections.lead: I take on a few engagements at a time, for teams that want AI in their products and want it done responsibly.
sections.cta: Tell me what you’re working on

items.title: Safety and evaluation
items.description: Red-teaming, evals and failure analysis for models and agents before they reach your users. You get a clear map of where they break and a plan to fix it.

items.title: From demos to production
items.description: For teams stuck between impressive prototypes and shipped features. We pick the workflows worth automating, build them properly and train your engineers to own them.

items.title: Fractional Chief AI Officer
items.description: Senior AI leadership a few days a month, without a full-time hire. I own the roadmap, model and vendor choices, hiring, and the governance your board will ask about.
